# 0062: A finished cell removes its workspace, and a project can keep them for inspection

Status: accepted, 2026-10-07.
Refines [0004](0004-workspace-is-a-plain-copy.md) (a workspace is a plain copy of the fixture tree) and [0032](0032-all-run-output-consolidates-under-a-cache-dir.md) (all run output consolidates under a cache dir) with when a workspace is removed.

## Context

A cell's workspace was removed only when the same cell ran again, so every cell of every sweep stayed on disk.
The mermaid skill's render step downloads its own browser into a task-local npm cache, about 675MB per cell.
By the first effort sweep the build tree held 19GB, the disk filled, and the sweep died at 16% mid-cell.

Nothing a later step reads lives in the workspace.
The session log, any subagent transcripts, the result and the metrics record are all copied under `results/`.
That happens before the cell is graded (ADR 0032, ADR 0033).
Each harness also keeps a run directory beside the workspace: claude's plugin wrapper, and codex's private home, which holds a copy of its credentials.

## Decision

**A finished cell removes its workspace and its harness run directories.** It happens after the cell's record is written, in a `finally`.
A cell whose CLI or grader failed is cleaned up too.

**Only the exact sibling names are removed.** They are `<workspace>.<harness>` for each registered harness, never a `<workspace>.*` pattern.
That pattern would also match a neighbouring cell's workspace, as `…-gpt-5` matches `…-gpt-5.6-sol`.

**A project keeps them for inspection with `xharness_keep_workspaces`, or `--xharness-keep-workspaces` for one run.** Both default to off.

## Consequences

A sweep's disk use stays at roughly one workspace per worker, however many cells it runs.
Codex's copied credentials no longer outlive the cell that needed them.

The files an agent wrote are no longer inspectable after the run unless the project keeps workspaces.
The written paths are still listed on every record, and the evidence a replay needs is unaffected.

## Lens

Scratch that outlives its purpose is not free.
Clean up by default once the evidence is safe.
Make keeping the scratch an explicit choice for the reader who needs it.
